title: Design: Deposit tooltip and toast keep a long customer name inside the box
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with a long name with no spaces that no other customer has, at least 50 characters (for example NorthernPlainsHeavyTruckandTrailerRepairServicesWest).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, a second payer, with a name that no other customer has and that includes each of the characters & " ' < > (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Parts> & Sons).
  • If a name field stops before the end of a name, use the longest name it takes.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Approved, billed to customer B, holding one deposit of $10.00 taken on its Finance tab after customer B was picked.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer A, in Approved, billed to customer C, holding one deposit of $10.00 taken on its Finance tab after customer C was picked.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p3-07-after-hover.png, bt-p3-08-after-click.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Hover over the Bill To field.
  4. Click the Bill To field.
  5. Open work order 2.
  6. Expand the Customer card.
  7. Hover over the Bill To field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • The tooltip reads "This work order has a $10.00 deposit from [customer B's name]. Reverse it, change the Bill To, then take the deposit again under the new Bill To."
  • The whole message stays inside the tooltip's box: no part of it runs past the box or off the screen.

Step 4:

  • An error toast shows the same message with "Open Deposits".
  • The whole message stays inside the toast: no part of it runs past the toast or covers "Open Deposits".
  • "Open Deposits" is fully visible.

Step 5:

  • Work order 2 opens for customer A.

Step 6:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer C's name.

Step 7:

  • The tooltip reads "This work order has a $10.00 deposit from [customer C's name]. Reverse it, change the Bill To, then take the deposit again under the new Bill To."
  • Customer C's name shows exactly as saved: the & " ' < > characters appear as typed, not changed into other characters or codes.
  • The whole message stays inside the tooltip's box.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits)

  • User Feedback Summary: “M1 | Change the Bill To while one deposit is held | "This work order has a [$amount] deposit from [customer]. Reverse it, change the Bill To, then take the deposit again under the new Bill To." | Field tooltip; on click, error toast with "Open Deposits"”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794510417-a68d (its boards are byte-identical to version 1794239066-4906 read 9 Nov 2026), read 13 Nov 2026: pictures "Hover" (page 3 "When the Bill To is blocked", This build), "Click" (page 3 "When the Bill To is blocked", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p3-07-after-hover.png
  • bt-p3-08-after-click.png

The design's own words:

  • “Tooltip: "This work order has a $10.00 deposit from 7 Star Truck Repair. Reverse it, change the Bill To, then take the deposit again under the new Bill To."”
  • “Error toast with the same words, "Open Deposits" and "Close". "Open Deposits" opens the Deposits tab of the customer holding the largest share.”

The design draws this place with ordinary names only; it draws no long name without spaces and no name with & " ' < >. The stress check follows the design-case checklist (lesson L-21); the expected words come from the PRD quotes above.
